import copy, json
from work import evaluate

def check(name, request, evidence, policy, expected):
    before = copy.deepcopy((request, evidence, policy))
    actual = evaluate(request, evidence, policy)
    assert actual == expected, (name, actual, expected)
    assert (request, evidence, policy) == before, name + ' mutated inputs'
    print(name + ': ' + json.dumps(actual, sort_keys=True))

p={'required_conditions':['recipe','calibration'],'require_verified':True}
check('missing_calibration', {'claim':'rate','conditions':{'recipe':'R'}}, [], p, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['calibration']})
check('verified_filter', {'claim':'rate','conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':None}}, [
 {'source':'U','claim':'rate','value':99,'conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':None},'verified':False},
 {'source':'V','claim':'rate','value':0,'conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':None},'verified':True}], p, {'status':'supported','value':0,'sources':['V'],'unknowns':[]})
check('eligible_supersession', {'claim':'rate','conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':2}}, [
 {'source':'A','claim':'rate','value':1,'conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':2},'verified':True},
 {'source':'B','claim':'rate','value':2,'conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['A']},
 {'source':'X','claim':'rate','value':7,'conditions':{'recipe':'other','calibration':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['B']},
 {'source':'W','claim':'rate','value':8,'conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':2},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True,'supersedes':['B']}], p, {'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['B'],'unknowns':[]})
check('canonical_agreement', {'claim':'obj','conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':3}}, [
 {'source':'Z','claim':'obj','value':{'b':[2,1],'a':1},'conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':3},'verified':True},
 {'source':'A','claim':'obj','value':{'a':1,'b':[2,1]},'conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':3},'verified':True}], p, {'status':'supported','value':{'b':[2,1],'a':1},'sources':['A','Z'],'unknowns':[]})
check('count_not_authority', {'claim':'flag','conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':4}}, [
 {'source':'A','claim':'flag','value':True,'conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':4},'verified':True},
 {'source':'B','claim':'flag','value':True,'conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':4},'verified':True},
